Antoni van Leeuwenhoek
Department of Radiology
Date: 15 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI prostate

Clinical indication: PSA 9.2 ng/mL (rising trend from 5.5 ng/mL in Jul 2024), prior systematic biopsy negative. Evaluate for suspicious focal lesion.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume is 57.0 mL.
T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of low signal intensity in the peripheral zone of the left posterolateral base, measuring approximately 12 mm in maximum dimension. This region shows restricted diffusion on high b-value DWI (b=1400) with corresponding hyperintensity on the ADC map. Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) sequences reveal early, marked enhancement of the lesion relative to the surrounding peripheral zone tissue. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is visualized. Neurovascular bundles appear intact. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or bone lesions are identified in the field of view.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS v2.1 score 4: Suspicious lesion in the left peripheral zone.
Prostate volume 57.0 mL; PSA density 0.16 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical T stage: cT2a.
csPCa predicted probability 0.7709042.
